en.tldr: Savings Plans lower eligible usage costs in exchange for a one- or three-year commitment measured in $/hour. Choose Compute Savings Plans when usage may move across EC2 families or Regions, or to Fargate or Lambda; choose EC2 Instance Savings Plans for the lowest prices when usage will stay in one EC2 family and Region.
whenToUse: A steady hourly compute baseline is expected, but its EC2 family, Region, or service may change: consider Compute Savings Plans.
Steady EC2 usage will remain in one instance family and Region, and the priority is the lowest price: consider EC2 Instance Savings Plans.
A workload needs both discounted usage and guaranteed EC2 capacity: pair an applicable Savings Plan with an On-Demand Capacity Reservation.
keyFacts: Savings Plans require a $/hour usage commitment for one or three years; usage beyond the commitment is charged at On-Demand rates.
Compute Savings Plans apply to EC2 regardless of family, size, operating system, tenancy, or Region, and also apply to Fargate and Lambda.
EC2 Instance Savings Plans cover a selected EC2 family in a selected Region, regardless of Availability Zone, size, operating system, or tenancy.
EC2 Instance Savings Plans offer the lowest prices of the two types; Compute Savings Plans offer more flexibility.
Savings Plans do not reserve EC2 capacity.
gotchas: Changing size or Availability Zone within the chosen family and Region does not, by itself, require a Compute Savings Plan.
An EC2 Instance Savings Plan does not extend its discount to Fargate, Lambda, another EC2 family, or another Region.
A discounted usage commitment is not a capacity guarantee.
Do not commit to a variable peak merely because a steady baseline exists; usage beyond the commitment can remain On-Demand.

confusedWith.difference: EC2 Reserved Instances can discount steady EC2 usage, but Compute Savings Plans also follow eligible usage across EC2 families and Regions, Fargate, and Lambda.
Spot suits interruptible work; a Savings Plan discounts eligible usage without making the workload interruptible.
A Capacity Reservation addresses capacity availability; a Savings Plan addresses eligible usage pricing and does not reserve capacity.

examCues: steady hourly baseline with a planned move to Fargate
EC2 family and Region will remain fixed
change instance size within the same family

es.tldr: Savings Plans reducen el costo del uso elegible a cambio de un compromiso de uno o tres años medido en $/hora. Elige Compute Savings Plans si el uso puede cambiar de familia o Region de EC2, o pasar a Fargate o Lambda; elige EC2 Instance Savings Plans para obtener el precio más bajo si el uso permanecerá en una familia y Region de EC2.
whenToUse: Esperas una base estable de uso por hora, pero podría cambiar la familia, la Region o el servicio: considera Compute Savings Plans.
El uso estable de EC2 permanecerá en una familia y Region, y buscas el precio más bajo: considera EC2 Instance Savings Plans.
Necesitas tanto un descuento como capacidad garantizada de EC2: combina un Savings Plan aplicable con una On-Demand Capacity Reservation.
keyFacts: Savings Plans requieren un compromiso de uso en $/hora durante uno o tres años; el uso que exceda el compromiso se cobra a tarifa On-Demand.
Compute Savings Plans se aplican a EC2 sin importar la familia, el tamaño, el sistema operativo, la tenencia o la Region; también se aplican a Fargate y Lambda.
EC2 Instance Savings Plans cubren una familia de EC2 en una Region seleccionada, sin importar la Availability Zone, el tamaño, el sistema operativo o la tenencia.
EC2 Instance Savings Plans ofrecen los precios más bajos de los dos tipos; Compute Savings Plans ofrecen mayor flexibilidad.
Savings Plans no reservan capacidad de EC2.
gotchas: Cambiar el tamaño o la Availability Zone dentro de la familia y Region seleccionadas no exige, por sí solo, un Compute Savings Plan.
Un EC2 Instance Savings Plan no extiende su descuento a Fargate, Lambda, otra familia de EC2 ni otra Region.
Un compromiso de uso con descuento no garantiza capacidad.
No incluyas un pico variable en el compromiso solo porque existe una base estable; el uso que exceda el compromiso puede seguir a tarifa On-Demand.

confusedWith.difference: EC2 Reserved Instances pueden descontar uso estable de EC2, pero Compute Savings Plans también siguen el uso elegible entre familias y Regions de EC2, Fargate y Lambda.
Spot sirve para trabajos que toleran interrupciones; un Savings Plan descuenta el uso elegible sin hacer que la carga sea interrumpible.
Una Capacity Reservation resuelve la disponibilidad de capacidad; un Savings Plan reduce el precio del uso elegible y no reserva capacidad.

examCues: steady hourly baseline with a planned move to Fargate
EC2 family and Region will remain fixed
change instance size within the same family

questions.stem: A media company runs a steady baseline of video-processing workers on EC2. Over the next year, it plans to change instance families, move some workers to another AWS Region, and run part of the pipeline on Fargate. The company wants one commitment type that will continue discounting eligible baseline usage through those changes. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST flexibility?

options.text: Run the workers on Spot Instances instead of making a usage commitment.
options.why: Spot does not provide the requested commitment-based discount across the planned EC2 and Fargate usage.

options.text: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for the steady hourly baseline.
options.why: It applies to eligible EC2 usage across families and Regions and to Fargate usage.

options.text: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the workers' current family and Region.
options.why: Its discount would not follow the workers to another family, Region, or Fargate.

options.text: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances for the workers' current configuration.
options.why: They do not provide the requested single commitment that follows usage from EC2 to Fargate.

questions.explanation: The deciding requirement is that discounted baseline usage must follow changes in EC2 family and Region and a move to Fargate. A Compute Savings Plan covers those eligible compute choices under a $/hour commitment. An EC2 Instance Savings Plan is tied to an EC2 family in one Region, while an EC2 Reserved Instance does not cover the planned Fargate usage. Spot is a different purchasing option rather than the requested steady-usage commitment.
keywordCues: move some workers to another AWS Region
run part of the pipeline on Fargate

es.stem: Una empresa de medios ejecuta una carga base estable de procesamiento de video en EC2. Durante el próximo año, planea cambiar de familia de instancias, mover parte del procesamiento a otra AWS Region y ejecutar otra parte en Fargate. Quiere un solo tipo de compromiso que siga descontando el uso base elegible durante esos cambios. ¿Qué solución cumple estos requisitos con la MOST flexibility?

options.text: Ejecuta el procesamiento en Spot Instances en lugar de asumir un compromiso de uso.
options.why: Spot no proporciona el descuento basado en un compromiso solicitado para el uso previsto de EC2 y Fargate.

options.text: Compra un Compute Savings Plan para la base estable de uso por hora.
options.why: Se aplica al uso elegible de EC2 entre familias y Regions, así como al uso de Fargate.

options.text: Compra un EC2 Instance Savings Plan para la familia y Region actuales.
options.why: Su descuento no seguiría el uso hacia otra familia, Region o Fargate.

options.text: Compra EC2 Reserved Instances para la configuración actual.
options.why: No proporcionan el compromiso único solicitado que siga el uso de EC2 a Fargate.

es.explanation: El requisito decisivo es que el descuento siga el uso base al cambiar de familia y Region de EC2 y al pasar a Fargate. Un Compute Savings Plan cubre esas opciones de cómputo elegibles mediante un compromiso en $/hora. Un EC2 Instance Savings Plan se limita a una familia de EC2 en una Region, mientras que un EC2 Reserved Instance no cubre el uso previsto de Fargate. Spot es otra opción de compra, no el compromiso solicitado para el uso estable.

questions.stem: A hospital must keep EC2 capacity available in a particular Availability Zone for a continuously running application. Its EC2 family and Region will remain unchanged, and it also wants the lowest Savings Plans price on its predictable usage. The purchasing approach must address capacity availability and usage cost separately. Which TWO actions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.text: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the application's family and Region.
options.why: It provides the lowest Savings Plans prices for the stable family and Region, though it does not reserve capacity.

options.text: Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation in the required Availability Zone.
options.why: It reserves EC2 capacity in the specified Availability Zone and can be used alongside a Savings Plan.

options.text: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan instead of reserving capacity.
options.why: A Compute Savings Plan does not reserve capacity and is not the lowest-priced Savings Plans type for this fixed family and Region.

options.text: Use a Dedicated Host instead of a capacity reservation and Savings Plan.
options.why: A Dedicated Host addresses dedicated-host needs rather than the requested combination of reserved capacity and a Savings Plans discount.

options.text: Use Spot Instances to ensure capacity is available in the required Availability Zone.
options.why: Spot is an interruptible purchasing option, not a capacity guarantee.

questions.explanation: This scenario has two separate requirements: discounted predictable usage and available capacity in a specific Availability Zone. An EC2 Instance Savings Plan offers the lowest Savings Plans prices for the unchanged family and Region. An On-Demand Capacity Reservation addresses the Availability Zone capacity requirement and can be paired with a Savings Plan. Neither type of Savings Plan reserves capacity on its own.
keywordCues: capacity available in a particular Availability Zone
family and Region will remain unchanged
capacity availability and usage cost separately

es.stem: Un hospital debe mantener disponible capacidad de EC2 en una Availability Zone específica para una aplicación que funciona continuamente. Su familia de EC2 y Region no cambiarán, y también quiere el precio más bajo de Savings Plans para su uso predecible. La estrategia de compra debe atender por separado la disponibilidad de capacidad y el costo de uso. ¿Qué DOS acciones cumplen estos requisitos? (Choose two.)

options.text: Compra un EC2 Instance Savings Plan para la familia y Region de la aplicación.
options.why: Ofrece los precios más bajos de Savings Plans para esa familia y Region estables, aunque no reserva capacidad.

options.text: Crea una On-Demand Capacity Reservation en la Availability Zone requerida.
options.why: Reserva capacidad de EC2 en la Availability Zone indicada y puede usarse junto con un Savings Plan.

options.text: Compra un Compute Savings Plan en lugar de reservar capacidad.
options.why: Un Compute Savings Plan no reserva capacidad y no es el tipo de Savings Plans con el precio más bajo para esta familia y Region fijas.

options.text: Usa un Dedicated Host en lugar de una reserva de capacidad y un Savings Plan.
options.why: Un Dedicated Host atiende necesidades de host dedicado, no la combinación solicitada de capacidad reservada y descuento de Savings Plans.

options.text: Usa Spot Instances para asegurar capacidad en la Availability Zone requerida.
options.why: Spot es una opción de compra interrumpible, no una garantía de capacidad.

es.explanation: Este escenario tiene dos requisitos distintos: descontar el uso predecible y disponer de capacidad en una Availability Zone específica. Un EC2 Instance Savings Plan ofrece los precios más bajos de Savings Plans para la familia y Region que no cambiarán. Una On-Demand Capacity Reservation atiende el requisito de capacidad y puede combinarse con un Savings Plan. Ningún tipo de Savings Plan reserva capacidad por sí solo.

questions.stem: A research organization uses consolidated billing for separate application accounts. One account has steady EC2 usage, while another has steady Lambda usage; both teams may change their compute mix during the next year. The finance team wants a single hourly commitment whose discount can apply to eligible usage across the accounts by default. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST commitment management?

options.text: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances for the EC2 account and use them for both accounts' compute usage.
options.why: EC2 Reserved Instances do not cover the Lambda usage specified in the scenario.

options.text: Purchase an On-Demand Capacity Reservation for the EC2 account and share its benefit across both accounts.
options.why: A capacity reservation does not provide the requested discount for eligible EC2 and Lambda usage.

options.text: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the EC2 account's current family and Region.
options.why: It does not discount the other account's Lambda usage or follow a change away from the selected EC2 family and Region.

options.text: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan within the consolidated billing family.
options.why: It covers eligible EC2 and Lambda usage and, by default, its benefit can apply across accounts in the consolidated billing family.

questions.explanation: The commitment must cover two eligible compute services and work across accounts under consolidated billing. A Compute Savings Plan applies to EC2 and Lambda, and Savings Plans benefits apply across accounts in a consolidated billing family by default. An EC2 Instance Savings Plan and EC2 Reserved Instances do not cover Lambda. A Capacity Reservation addresses EC2 capacity rather than this pricing requirement.

es.stem: Una organización de investigación usa consolidated billing para cuentas de aplicaciones separadas. Una cuenta tiene uso estable de EC2 y otra tiene uso estable de Lambda; ambos equipos podrían cambiar su combinación de cómputo durante el próximo año. El equipo de finanzas quiere un solo compromiso por hora cuyo descuento pueda aplicarse de forma predeterminada al uso elegible entre las cuentas. ¿Qué solución cumple estos requisitos con la LEAST commitment management?

options.text: Compra EC2 Reserved Instances para la cuenta de EC2 y úsalas para el cómputo de ambas cuentas.
options.why: EC2 Reserved Instances no cubren el uso de Lambda indicado en el escenario.

options.text: Compra una On-Demand Capacity Reservation para la cuenta de EC2 y comparte su beneficio entre ambas cuentas.
options.why: Una reserva de capacidad no proporciona el descuento solicitado para el uso elegible de EC2 y Lambda.

options.text: Compra un EC2 Instance Savings Plan para la familia y Region actuales de la cuenta de EC2.
options.why: No descuenta el uso de Lambda de la otra cuenta ni sigue un cambio fuera de la familia y Region de EC2 seleccionadas.

options.text: Compra un Compute Savings Plan dentro del grupo de consolidated billing.
options.why: Cubre el uso elegible de EC2 y Lambda y, de forma predeterminada, su beneficio puede aplicarse entre las cuentas del grupo de consolidated billing.

es.explanation: El compromiso debe cubrir dos servicios de cómputo elegibles y funcionar entre cuentas con consolidated billing. Un Compute Savings Plan se aplica a EC2 y Lambda, y los beneficios de Savings Plans se aplican de forma predeterminada entre las cuentas de un grupo de consolidated billing. EC2 Instance Savings Plans y EC2 Reserved Instances no cubren Lambda. Una Capacity Reservation atiende la capacidad de EC2, no este requisito de precios.

questions.stem: A manufacturer runs a predictable EC2 workload in one instance family and one AWS Region. It sometimes changes instance sizes and Availability Zones, but will not change families or Regions or move the workload to another compute service during its planned commitment. It wants the lowest Savings Plans price for this usage. Which option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text: Keep the workload entirely on On-Demand EC2 pricing.
options.why: On-Demand pricing forgoes the Savings Plans discount on the predictable usage.

options.text: Use an On-Demand Capacity Reservation for the selected instance family.
options.why: A capacity reservation addresses capacity availability, not the requested Savings Plans price.

options.text: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the chosen family and Region.
options.why: It offers the lowest Savings Plans prices and still covers size and Availability Zone changes within that family and Region.

options.text: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for the workload's hourly usage.
options.why: It provides flexibility the workload does not need, while EC2 Instance Savings Plans offer lower prices.

questions.explanation: The workload's family and Region remain fixed, so it does not need the broader coverage of a Compute Savings Plan. EC2 Instance Savings Plans offer the lowest prices for usage in a selected family and Region. Changing size or Availability Zone within those boundaries does not prevent the plan from applying. A Capacity Reservation would address a different requirement.
keywordCues: one instance family and one AWS Region
changes instance sizes and Availability Zones

es.stem: Un fabricante ejecuta una carga predecible de EC2 en una familia de instancias y una AWS Region. A veces cambia los tamaños de instancia y las Availability Zones, pero durante el compromiso previsto no cambiará de familia, Region ni servicio de cómputo. Quiere el precio más bajo de Savings Plans para ese uso. ¿Qué opción cumple estos requisitos de la manera MOST cost-effective?

options.text: Mantén toda la carga con precios On-Demand de EC2.
options.why: Los precios On-Demand dejan sin aprovechar el descuento de Savings Plans sobre el uso predecible.

options.text: Usa una On-Demand Capacity Reservation para la familia seleccionada.
options.why: Una reserva de capacidad atiende la disponibilidad de capacidad, no el precio de Savings Plans solicitado.

options.text: Compra un EC2 Instance Savings Plan para la familia y Region elegidas.
options.why: Ofrece los precios más bajos de Savings Plans y sigue cubriendo cambios de tamaño y Availability Zone dentro de esa familia y Region.

options.text: Compra un Compute Savings Plan para el uso por hora de la carga.
options.why: Ofrece una flexibilidad que la carga no necesita, mientras que EC2 Instance Savings Plans ofrecen precios más bajos.

es.explanation: La familia y la Region permanecerán fijas, por lo que la carga no necesita la cobertura más amplia de un Compute Savings Plan. EC2 Instance Savings Plans ofrecen los precios más bajos para el uso de una familia y Region seleccionadas. Los cambios de tamaño o Availability Zone dentro de esos límites no impiden que se aplique el plan. Una Capacity Reservation atendería otro requisito.

recall.prompt: A steady workload may move from one EC2 family to Fargate. Which Savings Plan fits, and why?
recall.promptEs: Una carga estable podría pasar de una familia de EC2 a Fargate. ¿Qué Savings Plan elegirías y por qué?
recall.idealAnswer: Choose a Compute Savings Plan for the predictable hourly usage. Its discount can apply across EC2 families and also to eligible Fargate usage, unlike an EC2 Instance Savings Plan.
rubric: Explains coverage across EC2 families and Fargate.
Ties the purchase to predictable hourly usage.

recall.prompt: Why is a Savings Plan alone insufficient when an application must have EC2 capacity available in a specific Availability Zone?
recall.promptEs: ¿Por qué un Savings Plan por sí solo no basta si una aplicación debe tener capacidad de EC2 disponible en una Availability Zone específica?
recall.idealAnswer: Savings Plans discount eligible usage but do not reserve EC2 capacity. Use an On-Demand Capacity Reservation for capacity in the required Availability Zone; an applicable Savings Plan can provide a discount alongside it.
rubric: States that Savings Plans do not reserve capacity.
Names On-Demand Capacity Reservation for the Availability Zone capacity requirement.
Distinguishes the capacity guarantee from the usage discount.
